/perfil/escultor/helena-vazquez.title: Helena Vázquez, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/helena-vazquez.description: Toledo, Spain. Figurative bronze. Three decades working the human figure through the slow craft of the studio.

/perfil/escultor/carmen-aldea.title: Carmen Aldea, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/carmen-aldea.description: Almería, Spain. Macael marble carving. Combines classical references and triadic forms that structure space from a single block.

/perfil/escultor/marcos-iriarte.title: Marcos Iriarte, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/marcos-iriarte.description: Bilbao, Spain. Bronze and glazed ceramic. His work explores the confluence of organic volumes with warm surfaces.

/perfil/escultor/alba-costa.title: Alba Costa, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/alba-costa.description: Valencia, Spain. Marble and fold. Treats stone like fabric: folds, creases and tensions that humanise the mineral block.

/perfil/escultor/diego-lara.title: Diego Lara, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/diego-lara.description: Seville, Spain. Corten steel and red glass. Investigates natural oxidation and contained light as sculptural materials.

/perfil/escultor/ada-la-cadena.title: Ada La Cadena, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/ada-la-cadena.description: The Art of the Intangible Ada La Cadena (Spain) is a multidisciplinary artist whose practice moves between painting and ceramic sculpture with a single obs

/perfil/escultor/lucia-pardo.title: Lucía Pardo, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/lucia-pardo.description: Porto, Portugal. Glazed ceramic in short series. Her work explores the origin of volume through the wheel and matt glaze.

/perfil/escultor/pablo-reyes.title: Pablo Reyes, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/pablo-reyes.description: Madrid, Spain. Stylised figurative bronze. Works the elongated figure as a human echo: vertical, quiet pieces.

/perfil/escultor/ines-ferrer.title: Inés Ferrer, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/ines-ferrer.description: Zaragoza, Spain. Carved alabaster. Pursues stillness and translucent light in pieces hand-polished over months.

/perfil/escultor/tomas-vigo.title: Tomás Vigo, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/tomas-vigo.description: Vigo, Spain. Glass blown in his own furnace. His Effusion series traps incandescent glass within oxidised iron structures.

/perfil/escultor/ana-ruiz.title: Ana Ruiz, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/ana-ruiz.description: Bilbao, Spain. Polished steel in annular forms. Investigates the flow of air and gaze through the open circle.

/perfil/escultor/camila-soler.title: Camila Soler, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/camila-soler.description: Buenos Aires, Argentina. Bronze and brass in suspended orbits. Combines astronomy and metalwork in mid-scale pieces.

/perfil/escultor/mateo-rivas.title: Mateo Rivas, Sculptor · Ignia Institution
/perfil/escultor/mateo-rivas.description: Quito, Ecuador. Green stone carved into minimal forms. His work reduces volume to an essential, almost architectural mineral.
